_comment: Tileable material prompts, derived directly from docs/WORLD.md section 8.3 and constrained by the rules in 8.4. Keep prompts SHORT -- CLIP truncates at 77 tokens, and every token spent on scene description is a token not spent on the material itself. Zone drives the palette: 'inhabited' is warm/saturated, 'deep' is cold/desaturated, 'custody' is flat institutional and machine-printed.
shared_negative: person, people, character, furniture, room, scene, perspective, vanishing point, horizon, text, watermark, signature, border, frame, vignette, glowing screen, neon, chrome, retrofuturism, 1950s, clean, new, pristine

zone_style.inhabited: top-down flat lay, evenly lit, sodium amber tint, verdigris and rust accents, worn but maintained, patched and repaired, seamless tileable texture, PBR albedo
zone_style.deep: top-down flat lay, evenly lit, cold desaturated grey, wet, mineral, unmaintained, seamless tileable texture, PBR albedo
zone_style.custody: top-down flat lay, evenly lit, flat institutional grey-green, machine printed, uniform, cold, seamless tileable texture, PBR albedo
